blocks.tamil_translation: Do not mock him (in a way that hurts his feelings)! Do not make promises in matters that you cannot fulfil.” Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: آيَةُ الْمُنَافِقِ ثَلَاثٌ: اِذَا حَدَّثَ كَذَبَ، وَاِذَا وَعَدَ اَخْلَفَ، وَاِذَا ائْتُمِنَ خَانَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب خصال المنافق، رقم:٢١١
blocks.tamil_translation: “The signs of a hypocrite are three: when he speaks, he lies; when he makes a promise, he does not fulfil it; and when an Amanah (some property for safekeeping) is entrusted (to him), he betrays it.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ قَتَّاتٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب ما يكره من النميمة، رقم: ٦٠٥٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Hudhaifah (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say, “The talebearer will not enter Jannah.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Talebearing is one of the major sins that are an obstacle to going to Jannah; no one can enter Jannah with this evil habit. But he will go to Jannah after Allah Ta'ala forgives him by His grace and mercy, or after He purifies him by giving him the punishment due for that sin.
(Ma'ariful Hadith)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ خُرَيْمِ بْنِ فَاتِكٍ ﵁ قَالَ: صَلَّي رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ صَلَاةَ الصُّبْحِ فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَامَ قَائِمًا فَقَالَ: عُدِلَتْ شَهَادَةُ الزُّوْرِ بِاْلاِشْرَاكِ
